title: Leave Sync for YouTrack – settings
description: Connection to Microsoft Teams Shifts (Microsoft Graph app registration) and who may manage leave.

demoMode.title: Use demo data (no Microsoft connection)
demoMode.description: Try the app without Microsoft 365: sample Teams Shifts time off is generated for the employees you add. The Microsoft settings below are ignored while this is on. Your real leave, links and leave types are kept and only hidden while this is on. Turn it off to go back to them.

tenantId.title: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
tenantId.description: Directory (tenant) ID of your Microsoft 365 organization.

clientId.title: Application (client) ID
clientId.description: Client ID of the app registration that has Schedule.Read.All and User.Read.All application permissions.

clientSecret.title: Client secret
clientSecret.description: Client secret value of the app registration.

teamIds.title: Teams team IDs
teamIds.description: ID of the team(s) whose Shifts schedule holds the time off. Separate several IDs with commas.

adminGroup.title: Leave administrators group
adminGroup.description: Members of this group can manage leave. System administrators always can.
